description: Generate production-ready Spring Boot REST APIs from natural language
post_install:
'@echo off',
    '  set JAVA_CMD=java',
    '  if ("%JAVA_HOME%") set JAVA_CMD=%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe',
    '  "%JAVA_CMD%" -jar "%~dp0companion.jar" %*',
    '  exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%' | Set-Content -Encoding ASCII $shim

'#!/bin/bash',
    '  set -euo pipefail',
    '  JAVA_CMD="java"',
    '  if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then JAVA_CMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"; fi',
    '  "$JAVA_CMD" -jar "$(dirname "$0")/companion.jar" "$@"' | Set-Content $sh
